source.name: 組織カレンダー for Microsoft 365
source.publisher: 株式会社ネクストセット

mapping.summary: Hierarchical organisation calendar for Microsoft 365, viewed in Teams and SharePoint.
claims: Shows organisations and groups as a tree hierarchy
Books several members and a meeting room in one step, including recurring schedules
Blocks double booking of meeting rooms
Exports displayed calendar data to CSV
Can be placed as an app part on a SharePoint site
mapping.hideReason: No sign of Business Central in the listing; a generic Microsoft 365 calendar tool with no business process.
